# DOC-3724FD572867 W-C6 Specify: schema_form (DVP-TSK-824)

**Project**: devops
**Related**: DVP-TSK-824, DVP-PLN-007, DVP-FTR-098, DOC-24F0950D339A, DOC-04829C0677A3, DOC-3E8F94E6B1E2, DOC-AEF68227FEBB, DOC-85B6774DAC96, DOC-90930433E582, DOC-7789FF132F90, DOC-5132058DFFAB
**Author**: DVP-TSK-824 subagent of ENC-SES-0IT (claude sonnet)
**Created**: 2026-10-10

## 0. Scope and inputs

Specifies `@io-kit/schema_form`: given an action contract, render a form, preview the exact resolved call (dry run), execute, and show a receipt. Claims are tagged `[DOC]` (traceable to a pack input) or `[INF]` (inference).

```yaml
inputs:
  DOC-24F0950D339A: W-B6 research (s2 SOTA, s5 candidate API, s6 MCP contract handling, s7 open decisions)
  DOC-04829C0677A3: capability inventory s1 counts (220 actions, 7 surfaces) and s2 schema retrievability
  DOC-3E8F94E6B1E2: prior spec s3.2 Tools form (dry run shows route, principal, governance_hash, body, side-effect count; ids server-minted)
  DOC-AEF68227FEBB: enceladus audit cell (schema_form absent; writes hand-coded)
  DOC-85B6774DAC96: vagamod audit cell (partial; zod schemas MCP-side; generateId)
  DOC-90930433E582: think audit cell (absent; nine hardcoded write actions; server supports dry_run; per-step echo)
  DOC-7789FF132F90: coach audit cell (absent; 511-line WritePage; presignContract)
not_available:
  - Per-action annotation (readOnlyHint etc.) coverage per surface: not in pack [INF: treat as unknown, apply cautious defaults]
  - Whether io-finance, io-travel, chosen-family, io-devops, Vagamod handlers implement dry_run: not in pack [INF: assume no]
  - Verified handler-level required/optional args for the 55 Enceladus actions: inventory says "unspecified"
  - No repos or records were re-read (brief forbids it)
```

Of the 220 actions, 129 (Enceladus 105 + io-graph 24) sit behind name-only wrappers and cannot be rendered until a backend returns schemas. [DOC: DOC-04829C0677A3 s2; DOC-24F0950D339A s1]

## 1. Canonical kit schema_form API (AC1)

Follows DOC-24F0950D339A s5-s6 with these departures, each marked: (a) ResolvedCall gains `governanceHash` and `principal`, because DOC-3E8F94E6B1E2 s3.2 requires the dry run to show auth principal, governance_hash and side-effect count [DOC]; (b) ResolvedCall gains `sideEffects` (count and kinds) for the same reason [DOC]; (c) `ExecuteResult.problem` is mandatory on failure so field mapping never depends on free text [INF]; (d) a `schemaSource` of `missing` forbids `execute` without typed confirmation, matching W-B6 s6 [DOC].

### 1.1 Contract A: ActionContract and registry (supplies the schema)

```ts
export type JSONSchema = Record<string, unknown>; // JSON Schema 2020-12 default dialect
export interface ActionContract {
  surface: SurfaceId; action: string; title: string; description?: string;
  inputSchema: JSONSchema; outputSchema?: JSONSchema;
  annotations: { readOnlyHint: boolean; destructiveHint: boolean; idempotentHint: boolean; openWorldHint: boolean };
  schemaSource: "declared" | "unwrapped" | "derived" | "missing";
  schemaHash: string;              // sha256 over canonical JSON of inputSchema
  requiresGovernanceHash: boolean; // Enceladus registry flag [DOC: DOC-04829C0677A3 s2]
  trust: "first-party" | "third-party";
}
export type SurfaceId = "enceladus" | "vagamod" | "io-finance" | "io-travel" | "io-devops" | "chosen-family" | "io-graph";
export interface WrapperSpec {
  tool: string;                    // "execute" | "coordination"
  discover: string;                // "search" or a surface-specific schema-listing action
  toArgs: (action: string, args: unknown, dryRun: boolean) => unknown;
}
export interface ActionRegistry {
  get(surface: SurfaceId, action: string): ActionContract | undefined;
  list(f?: { surface?: SurfaceId; readOnly?: boolean; schemaSource?: ActionContract["schemaSource"] }): ActionContract[];
  manifest(): { kitVersion: string; actions: Array<Pick<ActionContract, "surface" | "action" | "schemaHash" | "schemaSource">> };
}
export function buildRegistry(contracts: ActionContract[]): ActionRegistry;
export function unwrap(client: SurfaceClient, opts?: { wrappers?: WrapperSpec[] }): Promise<ActionContract[]>;
```

```yaml
registry_contract:
  sources:   # [DOC: DOC-04829C0677A3 s2; DOC-24F0950D339A s6]
    declared: "tools/list gives per-tool JSON Schema (vagamod, io-finance, io-devops, io-travel, chosen-family)"
    unwrapped: "wrapper discovery action returns {name,title,inputSchema,outputSchema,annotations} per action (enceladus, io-graph) -- REQUIRES backend change"
    derived: "schema generated from handler validators (zod toJSONSchema or Standard JSON Schema) [INF]"
    missing: "no schema available; raw JSON editor"
  rules:
    - "annotation defaults when absent: readOnlyHint=false, destructiveHint=true, idempotentHint=false, openWorldHint=true [DOC: MCP spec via DOC-24F0950D339A s2.2]"
    - "x-io-* keywords are the only io extension namespace; unknown x-* are ignored, unknown standard keywords degrade the field to raw JSON"
    - "external $ref is never fetched; local $defs only [DOC: DOC-24F0950D339A s2.5]"
    - "manifest() is the CI parity source for DVP-FTR-098 (registry vs UI route manifest) [INF]"
    - "cache registry per surface using tools/list ttlMs/cacheScope when present; kit-pinned snapshot is the CI baseline (OD-4)"
```

### 1.2 Schema-to-widget mapping table (keyed by JSON Schema type/format)

```ts
export type WidgetId = "text" | "textarea" | "markdown" | "email" | "url" | "date" | "datetime" | "number" | "switch"
  | "radio" | "select" | "titledSelect" | "multiSelect" | "repeater" | "fieldset" | "collapsible"
  | "variantSwitch" | "refTypeahead" | "jsonEditor" | "hidden" | "placeholder";
export interface WidgetProps<V = unknown> { path: string; schema: JSONSchema; value: V; onChange(v: V): void;
  errors: string[]; readOnly: boolean; }
export type WidgetRegistry = Record<WidgetId, (p: WidgetProps) => JSX.Element>;
export function pickWidget(schema: JSONSchema, ctx: { depth: number; mode: "action" | "elicitation" }): WidgetId;
```

```yaml
schema_to_widget:   # evaluation order is top to bottom; first match wins; [DOC: DOC-24F0950D339A s2.5] unless tagged [INF]
  precedence:
    - "x-io-minted:true -> hidden in form, placeholder in preview and receipt"
    - "x-io-ref present -> refTypeahead"
    - "x-io-widget present and registered -> that widget (override hook, used by coach for bespoke UX) [INF]"
    - "keyword the kit cannot validate -> jsonEditor (server validation only)"
  string:
    default: text
    maxLength_gt_200: textarea
    x-io-widget_md: markdown (reuses @io-kit/md)
    format:
      email: email
      uri: url
      date: date
      date-time: datetime (browser local input, stored as ISO 8601 UTC)
    enum: see enum
    writeOnly_or_secret_names: "never rendered in form mode; elicitation URL mode only [DOC: MCP elicitation]"
  number_integer:
    widget: number (min, max, step from minimum/maximum/multipleOf)
    locale_note: "render as text input in locales whose decimal separator is not '.' (rjsf 6.10.1 fix) [DOC]"
  boolean: switch
  enum:
    le_5: radio
    gt_5: select
    oneOf_const_title: titledSelect
  array:
    items_enum: multiSelect
    items_anyOf_const_title: multiSelect
    items_object: repeater (add, remove, reorder; honours minItems/maxItems)
    items_string_with_x-io-ref: refTypeahead in multi mode (chip editor of ids) [DOC: DOC-3E8F94E6B1E2 s3.2 "array of ids -> chip editor"]
    items_other: repeater of the item widget
  object:
    depth_le_2: fieldset
    depth_gt_2: collapsible
    no_properties_or_additionalProperties_true: jsonEditor   # free-form wrapper "arguments" [DOC: DOC-04829C0677A3 s2 io_graph]
  composition:
    oneOf_anyOf_with_const_discriminator: variantSwitch (shared fields preserved on switch)
    oneOf_anyOf_without_discriminator: jsonEditor [INF]
    allOf: merged before rendering [INF]
    if_then_else: re-evaluated on change; a field with a server error is never hidden
    ref_defs: local resolution only
  elicitation_mode:
    allowed: "flat object of string/number/integer/boolean/enum shapes only [DOC: MCP elicitation]"
    outcome: accept | decline | cancel
x_io_vocabulary:   # frozen per kit major version (OD-5)
  x-io-widget: WidgetId override
  x-io-ref: "{kind: string, search: {surface, action}}"
  x-io-minted: boolean
  x-io-order: integer
  x-io-group: string
  x-io-sentence: "template with {pointer} slots, e.g. 'Create task {/title} in {/project_id}'"
```

### 1.3 Contract B: dry-run resolved-call preview

```ts
export interface ResolvedCall {
  v: 1; surface: SurfaceId; action: string; arguments: unknown; schemaHash: string;
  governanceHash?: string; principal?: string;           // shown in preview [DOC: DOC-3E8F94E6B1E2 s3.2]
  underlying: Array<{ handler: string; method: string; path: string; body?: unknown }>;
  sideEffects: { writeCount: number; kinds: string[] };  // 0 for reads
  sentence?: string; diff?: Array<{ pointer: string; before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
  placeholders: Array<{ pointer: string; label: string }>; // server-minted ids
  annotations: ActionContract["annotations"];
  idempotencyKey: string; warnings?: string[];
  source: "server-dry-run" | "client-preview";
}
export type DryRunFn = (args: unknown, ctx: { idempotencyKey: string; schemaHash: string }) => Promise<ResolvedCall>;
export function resolveCall(contract: ActionContract, values: unknown): ResolvedCall;      // client-preview, pure, no network
export function renderPreview(call: ResolvedCall): { json: string; sentence: string; diff?: ResolvedCall["diff"] };
export function confirmLevel(a: ActionContract["annotations"], src: ActionContract["schemaSource"]): "none" | "inline" | "typed";
```

```yaml
dry_run_contract:
  semantics:
    - "dry run performs zero writes and returns HTTP/route-level resolved calls [DOC: DOC-3E8F94E6B1E2 s3.2]"
    - "Enceladus dry_run (whole call or per step) is the reference implementation; ResolvedCall v1 generalises it [DOC: DOC-24F0950D339A s1; INF on generalisation]"
    - "io-graph server supports dry_run (iograph_mcp lambda_function.py:34) but the think UI never sends it [DOC: DOC-90930433E582]"
  request: "wrapper surfaces: execute({steps:[{action, arguments}], dry_run:true}); direct-tool surfaces: tool called with dry_run:true argument or sibling <tool>.dry_run action [INF]"
  response_invariants:
    - "v == 1 and source == 'server-dry-run' for anything executable"
    - "schemaHash echoes the hash the client sent; mismatch -> problem 409 and the form re-fetches the registry"
    - "placeholders[] lists every x-io-minted output field by JSON Pointer; the client never fabricates an id"
    - "sideEffects.writeCount == 0 for readOnlyHint actions"
  fallback: "no server dry-run available -> source:'client-preview' is displayed with a 'not server-verified' banner and execute is allowed only after typed confirmation [INF]"
  confirm_policy:   # [DOC: DOC-24F0950D339A s2.8 as INF]
    readOnlyHint_true: none
    write_non_destructive: inline
    destructiveHint_true: typed
    openWorldHint_true: external-effect banner added
    schemaSource_missing: typed
  preview_views: [json, sentence, diff_against_current_record_for_updates]
```

### 1.4 Contract C: execute

```ts
export type ExecuteFn = (call: ResolvedCall) => Promise<ExecuteResult>;
export interface ExecuteResult {
  ok: boolean; structuredContent?: unknown;
  minted?: Record<string, string>;        // JSON Pointer in outputSchema -> id
  echo?: Array<{ step: number; action: string; ok: boolean; summary?: string }>; // per-step receipt (think pattern)
  problem?: ProblemDetails;
  inputRequired?: { inputRequests: Record<string, JSONSchema>; requestState: string }; // MRTR
}
export interface ProblemDetails {
  type: string; title: string; status: number; detail?: string;
  errors?: Array<{ pointer: string; detail: string; code?: string }>;
}
export function mapProblemToFields(p: ProblemDetails): Record<string, string[]>;
export function nextIdempotencyKey(prev: string | undefined, valuesChanged: boolean): string;
```

```yaml
execute_contract:
  preconditions:
    - "accepts only a ResolvedCall with source 'server-dry-run' (or confirmed 'client-preview' per 1.3 fallback) and a schemaHash equal to the live registry hash; else 409 and re-preview [DOC: DOC-24F0950D339A s5 contract_rules]"
    - "values changed after dry run invalidate the ResolvedCall; the Execute button is disabled until a new dry run [INF]"
  idempotency:
    - "idempotencyKey generated once per form open, reused on retry, regenerated when values change [DOC: DOC-24F0950D339A s5]"
    - "header name and TTL undecided (OD-7)"
  errors:
    - "server validation is authoritative; failures are tool-execution errors (isError) not protocol errors [DOC: MCP spec via DOC-24F0950D339A s2.7]"
    - "ProblemDetails.errors[].pointer is mapped to field paths by mapProblemToFields; unmapped errors show in a form-level banner"
    - "a field with a server error is never hidden by if/then/else"
  mrtr: "resultType input_required -> render each inputRequests entry with mode='elicitation', retry with inputResponses and the requestState echoed unmodified [DOC: DOC-24F0950D339A s6]"
  receipt:
    - "show structuredContent against outputSchema; fill placeholders from minted; link to created record"
    - "multi-step calls render per-step echo (generalised from think curationEcho/conceptReviewEcho) [DOC: DOC-90930433E582; INF on generalisation]"
  authority: "kit never holds credentials; onDryRun and onExecute are host-supplied closures carrying the host's auth (cognito jwt, next-auth session, coach auth boundary) [INF]"
```

### 1.5 Contract D: server-minted id handling

```yaml
minted_id_contract:
  declaration: "input or output schema field carries x-io-minted:true; outputSchema MUST declare the minted field so the receipt can fill it [DOC: DOC-24F0950D339A s6]"
  rules:
    - "minted fields are omitted from the form and from arguments"
    - "preview renders a typed placeholder, e.g. <new DVP-TSK id>; never a guessed or client-generated id [DOC: DOC-3E8F94E6B1E2 s3.2 ENC-FTR-117 posture; DOC-85B6774DAC96 generateId server-side]"
    - "receipt replaces each placeholder pointer from ExecuteResult.minted or structuredContent"
    - "only the idempotency key may be client-generated, and it is not a resource id"
    - "id-reference inputs (x-io-ref) store an existing id selected through the surface's search action; they never accept a typed unseen id unless x-io-ref.allowFreeText is true [INF]"
    - "handles from creation tools are opaque, passed as ordinary arguments in later steps; Recipes bind them with $N.path [DOC: DOC-3E8F94E6B1E2 s3.3]"
  known_instances:   # [DOC]
    vagamod: "generateId in functions/src/mcp/tools/check-in.ts:11"
    think: "intake.presign returns upload target; node id derived server-side (iograph_mcp:741)"
    coach: "ULIDs from ulid.py for sort keys"
    enceladus: "tracker ids minted by tracker create actions (ENC-FTR-117 posture); no form surfaces them today [INF]"
```

## 2. Per surface: schema source sufficiency and backend change (AC2)

A surface is `sufficient: yes` when the kit can build a per-action ActionContract from what the surface serves today. Server dry-run support is tracked separately because it gates `execute`, not rendering.

```yaml
surfaces:   # [DOC: DOC-04829C0677A3 s1-s2; DOC-24F0950D339A s1, s6] unless tagged [INF]
  enceladus_v2:
    actions: 105
    schema_source: "tools/list returns wrapper shapes only (action+arguments, steps); per-action schemas not retrievable; coordination capabilities.get returns provider capabilities, not schemas"
    sufficient: no
    backend_change: "unwrapped action registry: search (or a new schemas action) returns {name,title,inputSchema,outputSchema,annotations,requiresGovernanceHash} per action from mcp_server/actions.py build_action_registries; plus backfill 55 actions with no static schema, generated from handler validators"
    dry_run: "supported (execute dry_run, whole or per step), returns resolved underlying calls"
  vagamod:
    actions: 12
    schema_source: "per-tool JSON Schema via tools/list (zod to JSON Schema)"
    sufficient: yes
    backend_change: "none for schema. Gaps outside AC2 scope: annotations coverage unverified; dry_run not present (DOC-85B6774DAC96)"
    dry_run: "absent [DOC: DOC-85B6774DAC96]"
  io_finance:
    actions: 62
    schema_source: "per-tool JSON Schema via tools/list (_tool_list_payload)"
    sufficient: yes
    backend_change: "none for schema. 40 writes need dry_run or run client-preview with typed confirm; annotations coverage unverified"
    dry_run: "unknown, assumed absent [INF]"
  io_travel:
    actions: 5

  io_devops:
    actions: 3
    schema_source: "per-tool JSON Schema via tools/list (tool_registry.list_tools)"
    sufficient: yes
    backend_change: "none; all 3 actions are read-only so no dry_run needed"

  chosen_family:
    actions: 9
```

## Inference register

```yaml
- I-1: "ResolvedCall governanceHash, principal and sideEffects added because DOC-3E8F94E6B1E2 s3.2 lists them in the dry-run render"
- I-2: "Direct-tool surfaces accept a dry_run argument or sibling action; the pack does not show which convention they would use"
- I-3: "Vagamod, io-finance, io-travel, chosen-family lack server dry_run (only Vagamod is confirmed absent by DOC-85B6774DAC96)"
- I-4: "Annotation coverage is unverified on all surfaces; cautious defaults apply"
- I-5: "sufficient:yes means schema-sufficient only; it does not assert schema quality or completeness of required/enum detail"
- I-6: "Action counts in the candidate list rationales derive from DOC-04829C0677A3 s1 arithmetic (5+40+3+2 = 50 writes)"
- I-7: "x-io-ref allowFreeText, mapping rows tagged INF, and allOf merge behaviour are specification choices not present in W-B6"
```
